title: 第11章 三族会面第12章 杀鸡儆猴
content_zh:
叶家议事厅内，沉重的紫檀木门缓缓开启。
往日空旷的厅堂此刻泾渭分明地坐着几波人马。
主位上，一位须发皆白的老者正闭目养神。
他面容枯瘦，鹰钩鼻下两撇灰白长须垂至胸前，十指交叉放在腹前，指甲修剪得一丝不苟。
这便是如今叶家实际的话事人——大长老叶鸿炎。
左手边坐着一位身材魁梧的中年男子。
此人浓眉如刀，满脸横肉，一道狰狞的刀疤从右额贯穿至左颊，将原本就粗犷的面容衬得更加凶悍。
他身披虎皮大氅，腰间悬着一柄鬼头大刀，正是林家家主林震山。
右手边则是个面带憨笑的胖子。
王家家主王富贵一身锦缎华服，圆脸上永远挂着人畜无害的笑容，活像个慈祥的土财主。
但若仔细观察，会发现他眯成缝的眼睛里偶尔闪过毒蛇般的精光。
厅内落针可闻，只有茶盏轻碰的脆响不时响起。
三位大佬各怀心思地品着茶，仿佛在进行一场无声的较量。
吱呀——
议事厅的大门被推开，叶福弓着身子快步走入。
他低着头，试图用散乱的头发遮住红肿的脸颊：大长老，尘少爷到了。
在座的都是玄罡境高手，叶福这点小动作如何瞒得过他们的眼睛？
叶鸿炎眉头一皱：你脸上的伤怎么回事？
回、回大长老...叶福嘴角抽搐，挤出一个比哭还难看的笑容，小的刚才去请尘少爷时，不小心摔了一跤...
林震山闻言，粗犷的脸上露出玩味的笑容；

王富贵则笑眯眯地喝了口茶，眼中闪过一丝讥讽。
滚出去！
叶鸿炎冷哼一声。
叶福如蒙大赦，连滚带爬地退了出去。
就在他退出门口的刹那，一道修长的身影与他擦肩而过。
叶霄尘一袭玄色长袍，步履从容地踏入议事厅。
他进来的一瞬间，议事厅众人的目光瞬间落到他的身上，
好一个翩翩公子！
这是所有人的第一感觉，就连熟悉叶霄尘的大长老也不例外，
自信~
张扬~
家里这个废物，什么时候有了这份气度？
察觉到众人的目光，叶霄尘不以为意，微笑着看了回去，并且用系统扫了一遍几人，
【姓名：叶鸿炎】
【修为：玄罡六重】
【天赋：凡品上阶玄脉】
【忠诚度：40100（心存轻视）】
【此时状态：因为王林两家的同时到来而苦恼】
叶霄尘目光微动，自己没有天赋，大长老看不惯自己很正常，
不过既然大长老和两家人没有交际，说明父亲的死和他没关系，

总体来说，不幸中的万幸。
叶霄尘又试着用系统扫描另外两人，却发现毫无反应，
果然，系统是不能识别外人的信息的。
content_en:
In the Ye family's meeting hall, the heavy rosewood door slowly opened.
The previously empty hall was now filled with distinct groups of people.
At the main seat, an old man with white hair and beard was closing his eyes to rest.
He has a thin face, two long gray beards under his aquiline nose hanging down to his chest, his fingers are interlocked in front of his abdomen, and his nails are meticulously trimmed.
This is now the actual talker of the Ye family - the great elder Ye Hongyan.
Sitting on the left is a burly middle-aged man.
This man has thick eyebrows like a knife, and his face is full of flesh. A ferocious scar runs from his right forehead to his left cheek, making his already rough face even more fierce.
Wearing a tiger-skin cloak and hanging a ghost-headed sword from his waist, he was Lin Zhenshan, the head of the Lin family.
On the right is a fat man with a silly smile.
Wang Fugui, the head of the Wang family, is dressed in brocade and rich clothes, with a harmless smile on his round face. He looks like a kind and wealthy man.
But if you look closely, you will find that there are occasional snake-like glints in his narrowed eyes.
The sound of a needle dropping could be heard in the hall, and only the crisp sound of teacups being touched could be heard from time to time.
The three bosses each sipped tea thoughtfully, as if engaging in a silent contest.
Squeak——
The door to the meeting hall was pushed open, and Ye Fu walked in quickly with his body hunched over.
He lowered his head and tried to cover his red and swollen cheeks with his messy hair: Great Elder, Master Chen is here.
Everyone here is a master of the Xuangang Realm. How could Ye Fu hide this little trick from their eyes?
Ye Hongyan frowned: What happened to the injury on your face?
Back to the elder... Ye Fu's mouth twitched and he forced out a smile that was uglier than crying. The younger one accidentally fell down when he went to invite Master Chen just now...
When Lin Zhenshan heard this, a playful smile appeared on his rough face;
Wang Fugui took a sip of tea with a smile, a hint of sarcasm flashing in his eyes.
Get out!
Ye Hongyan snorted coldly.
Ye Fulu was pardoned and retreated crawling on the ground.
The moment he exited the door, a slender figure passed him.
Ye Xiaochen wore a black robe and walked calmly into the meeting hall.
The moment he came in, the eyes of everyone in the meeting room fell on him.
What a handsome young man!
This was everyone's first feeling, even the great elder who was familiar with Ye Xiaochen was no exception.
Confident~
Publicity~
When did this loser in the family gain such magnanimity?
Sensing everyone's gaze, Ye Xiaochen didn't take it seriously, looked back with a smile, and scanned several people with the system.
[Name: Ye Hongyan]
[Cultivation: Sixth level of Xuangang]
[Talent: Advanced Mortal Grade Mysterious Veins]
[Loyalty: 40100 (with contempt)]
[Status at this time: distressed by the arrival of Wang Lin’s family at the same time]
Ye Xiaochen's eyes moved slightly. He had no talent. It was normal for the elder to dislike him.
But since the great elder has no contact with the two families, it means that his father's death has nothing to do with him.
Overall, a blessing in misfortune.
Ye Xiaochen tried to scan the other two people with the system, but found no response.
Sure enough, the system cannot identify outsiders' information.
